# Test fixture (fictional business, for unit tests only)
## Opening hours
Our opening hours are 8am to 6pm, Monday to Friday. We are closed on bank holidays.
## Prices
A new patient check-up costs £65. A follow-up appointment costs £40.
## Parking
Parking is available behind the building, free for the first hour.
## NHS
We do not take NHS patients at the moment; all appointments are private.
